verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing says it tracks spend instantly against budgets and manages spend in real time. It also offers department-level budgets and in-app spend viewing, and AI agents categorize spend instantly, which supports same-day visibility. However, a dashboard breaking spend down by team, category, and merchant is never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a spend view by team, category, and merchant; evidence that transactions appear the same day; independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time reporting.
